outlook.statement: As per the Consultant's report the manufacturing of paper & paper board from Ambivali factory is not a viable business

The Company is evaluating various options available and intend to continue the Trading of Paper & Paper Boards business and Trading of plastic & packaging materials. Further, the Company will raise necessary funds for working capital requirements and other purposes.
